notes.title: Major Updates for Mountain Boy
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I’m excited to share the substantial progress I’ve made on Mountain Boy since the last version. The Steam page has been completely overhauled, and many placeholders have been replaced to reflect all the new improvements.

Thanks to the incredibly valuable feedback from the early access version, I’ve made some big updates:

[b]Climbing Gameplay Expanded[/b]
The climbing mechanics have been refined and expanded, with the addition of a couple of hidden mechanics that let you recover some stamina while climbing. These new features add more depth to the gameplay and give you new ways to approach challenges.

[b]Improved Visuals[/b]
I’ve enhanced the graphics in many areas, including new textures, sprites, VFX, and a light depth of field effect in the background for a more immersive experience. These changes bring a fresh, polished look to the game while keeping the pixel art charm intact.

[b]Redesigned HUD[/b]
The HUD has been completely reworked. It’s now dynamic and disappears when not needed, making it far less intrusive than before.

[b]New Coins and Shops[/b]
I’ve introduced two types of coins to collect while climbing, along with new shops where you can spend them. Now, with your coins, you can even purchase a ticket for an elevator ride!

[b][u]Looking Ahead:[/u][/b]
I plan to reopen the playtest soon, and if anyone would like to help improve the game, I’d really appreciate your feedback. This second playtest will be the foundation for creating the demo.

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Mountain Boy is Working Great on Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
Hello Mountain Climbers!

I’m excited to share that even though Mountain Boy is still in development, it’s already running smoothly on the Steam Deck! 🎉

During the early playtests, I’ve been able to enjoy the game on the Steam Deck myself, and I’m thrilled with how well it performs. This means that once the game is fully released, you’ll be able to embark on your mountain adventures seamlessly on your Steam Deck.

I’m continuing to work hard on the game, and ensuring a great experience on the Steam Deck is a top priority. Your feedback has been invaluable, and I’m grateful for your support as I refine and enhance Mountain Boy.

Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready to conquer those peaks anytime, anywhere with the Steam Deck!

Happy climbing!
